node.title: Re: Match something that does not match
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
It seems to me like the feature you're implementing could be described as "stop matching at" (Update: or "match until") rather than do_not_match. Your current regex in do_not_match can be simplified to qr{ (?: (?!$pat) . )* }x; at least that still passes all your test cases. (This regex is pretty simple; I'm not sure if it warrants inclusion in [mod://Regexp::Common].)

Update: [https://webperl.zero-g.net/regex.html#flags=x&pre=my%20%24pat%20%3D%20qr%7B%5Cb%5Baeiou%5D%5Ba-z%5D*ion%5Cb%7D%3B%0A®ex=%20(%3F%3A%20(%3F!%24pat)%20.%20)*&samp1=stimulated%20emission%20of%20radiation&samp2=electron%20transition&samp3=absorbtion%20of%20photons&samp4=light%20amplification%20by%20stimulated%20emission%20of%20radiation&samp5=electron%20impact%20ionization|WebPerl Regex Tester]
